request.name: arena-park-overview-flat-02
request.prompt: A small city park arena seen from above for a party brawler game: four dogs of different breeds each swinging their human owner around on a taut leash like a flail, the owners flying horizontally and calm, one teenager staring at his phone while airborne. A light circle marked on the central lawn where two dogs fight for position. Benches, a hot dog cart, a fountain, a few trees around the edges. Each dog has a collar and leash in one bright player color: red, blue, yellow, purple. Minimalist flat-shaded 3D render, very simple geometric shapes with smooth edges, solid unlit-looking colors, no gradients, no textures, no outlines, tiny dot eyes, limited muted palette of greens and beiges. Camera: high top-down view tilted about 60 degrees, whole arena in frame. No text, no UI.
